brief:
Mechanical extraction of the track half of PlayerViewModel into a coordinator object, behaviour-identical. Read inventory-2 fully first; it names every line range, field, call edge and the five places where the move is not mechanical.

STEP 1. New iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/Tracks/TrackSelectionPorts.swift: `struct TrackSelectionContext` (activePreparedProtocolV3, currentSelectedVersion, currentWatchDetail, activePlaybackSessionId, resolvedServerUrl, activeRouteKind, backendCapabilities, offlinePlaybackContext, currentTime, isBackgroundSuspended, isPlaying) and `struct TrackSelectionPorts` of closures: `backend: () -> AVPlayerBackend?` (concrete in wave 1; wave 3 swaps to `any PlaybackBackend`), `context: () -> TrackSelectionContext`, `requestReplan: (_ classification: String, _ message: String, _ protocolV3SubtitleIndex: Int?) -> Void` (maps onto PVM attemptProtocolV3Replan at the four sites PVM:5555/5588/5618/7458 — read how each passes position/classification and preserve per-site arguments; if the four calls differ in more than classification/message/subtitle index, give the port the extra parameters rather than approximating), `isReplanInFlight: () -> Bool` (PVM:7445 `protocolV3ReplanTask == nil`), `setLastLoadRequestProtocolV3SubtitleIndex: (Int?) -> Void` (PVM:7457), `showNotice`/`activeNotice`/`dismissNotice` (PVM:6133-6162), `scheduleHideControls: () -> Void`, `resolveServerUrl`.
STEP 2. New iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/Tracks/TrackSelectionCoordinator.swift: `@MainActor @Observable final class TrackSelectionCoordinator` with `init(ports:)`. MOVE (cut/paste, same bodies) from PlayerViewModel: all state in inventory-2 §1b + §7 'moves wholesale' (pendingExternalSubtitles, knownExternalSubtitles, TrackSelectionSnapshot, the pendingRecovered*, pendingAudioFfIndex, pendingSubtitleFfIndex, hasExplicitSubtitleChoice, pendingSidecarSubtitleTrackId, pendingServerRenderedSubtitleTrackId, pendingLiveSubtitleCloseTrackId, deferredLiveSubtitleCloseTask (keep it on PlayerTaskRegistry via a port or move the registry key usage — pick the smaller change and say which), prefsForCurrentItem/PrefsSnapshot, prefsResolvedForCurrentItem, subtitleOrderingLanguage, liveSubtitlePreparingNoticeId), the subtitleAI lazy controller + makeLiveSubtitleCoordinator, the 16 track code runs listed in §0 (5541-5706, 5714-5723, 5726-5892, 5893-5916, 5938-5972, 5989-6028, 6030-6168, 6170-6212, 6818-6900, 6901-7008, 7009-7065, 7067-7193, 7201-7305, 7306-7319, 7320-7464, 7856-8007) plus `orderedSubtitles` (:413), the appearance funnels that write selection state (:3204-3221 setSubtitleDeviceOverrideEnabled / setSubtitleMatchesSystemAppearance), resolvedAudioTrackIndexForResume / resolvedSubtitleTrackIndexForResume / resolvedProtocolV3SubtitleIndexForResume / resolvedSidecarSubtitleTrackIdForResume (:3549-3595), adoptProtocolV3RenewalIntent / rearmAdoptedProtocolV3TrackIntent / armAdoptedProtocolV3TrackIntent (:3596-3641), applySidecarRestoreIntent (:2502-2529), systemCaptionPrefsSnapshot / serverSubtitlePrefsSnapshot. The five stored published properties `audioTracks`, `subtitleTracks`, `selectedAudioId`, `selectedSubtitleId`, `selectedSecondarySubtitleId` MOVE to the coordinator; PlayerViewModel keeps forwarding computed properties with the same names (get-only where views only read; `@Observable` tracks the coordinator transitively because the VM holds it as a stored property and the getters read coordinator state). Every view-facing method in inventory-2 §5 keeps its name on the VM as a one-line forwarder (selectAudio, selectSubtitle, disableSubtitles, selectSecondarySubtitle, disableSecondarySubtitles, cycle*, toggleSubtitles, searchSubtitles, downloadSearchedSubtitle, startSubtitleTranslation/Transcription, subtitleSearchEnabled/Visible/UnavailableReason, orderedSubtitleTracks, availableSecondarySubtitleTracks, supportsSecondarySubtitles, hasTrackSelectionOptions, subtitleAI, setSubtitleMatchesSystemAppearance, setSubtitleDeviceOverrideEnabled) — no view file changes (verify with `git diff --stat` containing no Views).
STEP 3. The two fileprivate adapters (PVM:7856-8007) move into the coordinator's file with `owner` re-typed to the coordinator; the 14 `internal`-only-for-the-adapters forwarders become `private` on the coordinator (inventory-2 §5 last paragraph).
STEP 4. The five non-clean boundaries (inventory-2 §7): (a) `resetPublishedLoadState` → `coordinator.resetForLoad(...)` carrying the same 11 track writes (keep the parameter that decides whether track prefs are kept); (b) `adoptPreparedPlayback` track portion → `coordinator.adopt(prepared:origin:…)` with the identical per-origin branches; (c) `attemptNativeDirectRouteRecovery` snapshot/restore → `coordinator.snapshotForRecovery()` / `restoreAfterRecovery(_:)`; (d) `setSubtitleMatchesSystemAppearance` forwards; (e) `selectAudio` stays whole on the coordinator. `makeExecutionPlan` (PVM:2360-2364) and `makeFallbackLoopbackSession` (:6764-6766) read through `coordinator.` accessors. `wireSubtitleCallbacks` (:1194) and `onTracksChange` (:1334) call `coordinator.appendSidecarTracks` / `coordinator.applyTrackList` under the SAME generation guard (the guard stays in the VM closure). `runStartSession` (:3846-3860) reads `coordinator.systemCaptionPrefsSnapshot()`. `cleanup` (:6330-6336) calls `coordinator.reset()`.
STEP 5. Build all three schemes, run the suite (1539 + new tests). Write iosApp/Tests/TrackSelectionCoordinatorTests.swift using FakePlaybackBackend is NOT available in this wave (it is another package) — instead drive the coordinator with a ports struct whose `backend` returns nil and a tiny in-test `final class RecordingBackendShim` is NOT allowed either (no new doubles beyond the test file). Write ≥ 8 tests over the pure-ish paths: applyTrackList pending-ff order incl. `< 0` Off sentinel; pending-audio match; fuzzy TrackSelectionSnapshot threshold 3 (bestTrackMatch); appendSidecarTracks pending sidecar restore; server-rendered pending sets id without apply; forced-sidecar auto-select guard (subtitleMatchesSystemAppearance false/true × hasExplicitSubtitleChoice); suspended user commands are dropped; resetForLoad clears/keeps per parameter. (These exercise the coordinator with an empty backend port; assert on published ids + recorded replan/port calls.)

HARD BOUNDARIES: no behaviour change (same decision order, same reasons strings, same persist calls); no view file edits; no change to SubtitleAIController / LiveSubtitleCoordinator / SubtitleSession; PlayerViewModel.swift shrinks by ~1.4k lines; keep every `recordAudioTrackSelectionBreadcrumb`/`record…` call and its text.
invariants: Every decision site in inventory-2 §2 still exists with the same order and reason strings
Views compile untouched (git diff touches no file under Screens/Player/{iOS,tvOS,Sheets}, macOS/, Control/)
The generation guard on onTracksChange/onSidecarTracksRegistered stays in the VM closure
SubtitleAIController/LiveSubtitleCoordinator constructor closures receive the same values
Suite total = 1539 + tests added; all existing subtitle/track tests green
